text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fan Fests are held twice a year. The fall festival, otherwise known as the Solefall Faire, focuses more on stalls and cultural events.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One of these events is a student-held live concert. Some performers wind up forming lasting groups. However…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for turning up to see us! That was sooo much fun!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I never imagined the five of us would perform together. It's a little sad knowing this is the end.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right? I've yet to show everyone my ultra hip dance moves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We also haven't backflipped, cartwheeled, or somersaulted in time to the audience's applause.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hold on a second! I thought that was because we agreed on no acrobatics…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: There's still so many different things we'd like to do at a concert.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wow, I'm glad you feel that way! Another concert might be hard to pull off… but a video sounds doable, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: With video editing, I believe we could perform group stunts.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bourbon… It sounds to me like you're really into doing acrobatics.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Do you mean we're going to use one of those fancy videotape recorders? Wow, you cats really know how to stay ahead of the curve! Let's get the cameras rolling! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like everyone's into the idea! We've got more in store for you, so stay tuned!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm taking back our goodbyes for now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: See you all in next year's Solefall Faire, 'kay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Next year? So I have to do this again…
